equity.level_reason: Comparisons are across countries and years only; no social-position dimension is reported or analyzed.

level_alternative.reason: Countries are selected by World Bank high-income status and the Discussion cites affordable transportation goals, but country income group is geography, not an SPD.

equity.equity_measurement: Units are countries selected by World Bank high-income status (geography, not an SPD); no person-level social-position groups.

notes: Rates, percent changes and cross-country averages are arithmetic; no tests or CIs. Study design is inferred (none named); countries are the unit of analysis. A Discussion estimate of lives and medical costs saved at the average rate is a side calculation from WISQARS, not a headline claim.
